title: Normalized evaluation at F e is a unit orientation of range F, and det(F*∘F) > 0, for injective F
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let F : ℝⁿ → ℝᴾ be an injective continuous linear map; write b := (F e₁, …, F eₙ) with eⱼ = EuclideanSpace.single j 1. Then (i) det(F*∘F) > 0 (determinant of the endomorphism F.adjoint ∘L F of ℝⁿ), and (ii) every ξ ∈ MultiVector P n (a continuous linear functional on n-covectors of ℝᴾ) satisfying α(b) = √(det(F*∘F))·ξ(α) for every n-covector α is a unit orientation of the subspace range F, i.e. IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (range F): there is an orthonormal τ : Fin n → ℝᴾ with span(range τ) = range F such that either ξ(α) = α(τ) for all α, or ξ(α) = −α(τ) for all α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Injective F → 0 < (F.adjoint ∘L F).det ∧ ∀ ξ : MultiVector P n, (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, α (fun i => F (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) = Real.sqrt ((F.adjoint ∘L F).det) * ξ α) → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (LinearMap.range (F : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
